description:
Hearth Hub is a Ugandan innovation team participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Through our project, CookSmart Uganda, we aim to use NASA's open Earth observation data to analyse environmental trends, assess solar energy potential, and develop innovative, data-driven solutions that support Uganda's transition from traditional three-stone cooking to cleaner, smarter, and more sustainable cooking technologies.

Our Motto: From Space Data to Smarter Cooking.
